hadith:
Partnership - Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:

that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave him some sheep to distribute among his companions in order to sacrifice them and a kid was left. He told the Prophet (ﷺ) about it and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Sacrifice it on your behalf."
message: Reflect upon the transience of worldly pursuits as highlighted in Surah At-Takathur. Remember that true success lies in submission to Allah's will, as emphasized by the name Al Qahhaar. Strive to align your actions with divine wisdom, knowing that ultimate victory belongs only to Him.
name:
Al Qahhaar - الْقَهَّارُ - The Subduer

The name Al Qahhaar emphasizes Allah's sovereignty and ability to dominate all beings and situations. It reflects His authority and the inevitable defeat of all that opposes His will. The name inspires believers to submit to Allah's will, reminding them of His might and the transient nature of worldly power.
verse:
At-Takathur - The Rivalry in world increase - 102:5

Indeed, if you were to know ˹your fate˺ with certainty, ˹you would have acted differently˺.
